package.name: rc_car_controller
package.description: RC car controller that converts ackermann_msgs/AckermannDrive commands into servo (steering) and ESC (throttle) PWM signals using a PCA9685 on I2C bus 7 at address 0x40. The PCA9685 output-enable (OE) pin is wired to the Jetson Nano 40-pin header (GPIO09) and is held high during initialization, then driven low once the channels are configured to a safe 50 Hz / 1500 us state.
